question: 全站累计销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成')

question: 一共多少笔有效订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成')

question: 客单价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成')

question: 累计卖出多少件商品？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.qty) AS qty FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成')

question: 各城市的销售额是多少？按销售额从高到低排序
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 各品类的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 各渠道的订单数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY orders DESC

question: 各会员等级的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.level, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 2026年10月的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-10'

question: 上个月的订单数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-10'

question: 2026年各月的销售额趋势
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date)='2026' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

question: 销售额最高的3个城市是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 3

question: 成都各品类的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND c.city='成都' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 金卡会员贡献了多少销售额？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND c.level='金卡'

question: 直播渠道的订单数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND o.channel='直播'

question: 销量最高的5个商品是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2026年有多少个客户下过单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date)='2026'

question: 2026年9月和10月的销售额对比
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) IN ('2026-09','2026-10') GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym
